questions.q: The boy is ______ because his father is ill.
questions.ex: 爸爸生病了，孩子应该感到担心（worried）。

questions.q: If you follow the rules, the teachers will be ______.
questions.ex: 遵守规则老师会高兴（happy）。

questions.q: The opposite word of 'sad' is ______.
questions.ex: sad（伤心）的反义词是happy（开心）。

questions.q: Your friend is going to have a big match. He is nervous. You can say: ______
questions.ex: 安慰紧张的人可以使用'Don't worry'（不要担心）。

questions.q: 连词成句：you, How, feel, do, ?
questions.ex: 特殊疑问句结构：疑问词+助动词+主语+动词原形。

questions.q: 'wrong' 的意思是'错误的'，也可以在'What's wrong?'中表示'怎么了'。
questions.ex: wrong可以指错误，也可以指身体或情绪不适。

questions.q: 'worried' 表示'担心的'。
questions.ex: worried是形容词，表示忧虑或担心。

questions.q: 'do more exercise' 的意思是'做更多的练习'，只能指数学题复习。
questions.ex: do exercise通常指体育锻炼。

questions.q: In 'They are afraid of him', 'of' is necessary.
questions.ex: be afraid of 是固定搭配，表示害怕某人或某物。

questions.q: If you are angry, you should chase the cat.
questions.ex: 生气时不应该追逐猫，而应该冷静。

questions.q: I am ______ because my cat is lost.
questions.ex: 宠物丢了会感到伤心。

questions.q: How ______ your father feel today?
questions.ex: your father是第三人称单数，用does。

questions.q: You ______ be angry. You should take a breath.
questions.ex: 你不应该（shouldn't）生气。

questions.q: If you are ______ , you can wear more clothes.
questions.ex: 感到冷（cold）才会多穿衣服。

questions.q: Don't sit on the grass. The ants will be ______ .
questions.ex: 坐在草地上，蚂蚁（ants）会生气。

questions.q: —What's wrong? —______
questions.ex: What's wrong回答不适或生病的情况。

questions.q: My father is ______ with the cat for breaking the vase.
questions.ex: 猫打破花瓶，爸爸会生气。

questions.q: Sarah should ______ because she wants to be a faster runner.
questions.ex: 为了跑得快，需要多锻炼。

questions.q: Tomorrow is my birthday. I am ______ !
questions.ex: 生日快到了通常感到兴奋（excited）。

questions.q: ______ should I do if I feel sad?
questions.ex: What should I do? 表示我该做什么？

questions.q: 连词成句：be, Don't, with, angry, me, .
questions.ex: 祈使句的否定形式：Don't + 动词原形+其他。

questions.q: 在句型 'How can I get to the Fuxi Museum?' 中，get to 意为‘到达’。
questions.ex: get to 是固定短语，表示到达某地。

questions.q: 'pilot' 的意思是‘科学家’。
questions.ex: pilot 意为飞行员，科学家是 scientist。

questions.q: 寓言故事中的 'Setting' 通常指的是故事中的角色。
questions.ex: Setting 指的是背景或环境，Characters 指的是角色。

questions.q: 在句子 'Check it out' 中，Check 和 it 之间通常会发生连读。
questions.ex: 辅音k和元音i相连，通常需要连读。

questions.q: ‘Worried’ 的意思是‘生气的’。
questions.ex: Worried 是担心的，生气的应该是 angry。

questions.q: How ______ you feel today?
questions.ex: 询问感觉用助动词do配合动词原形feel。

questions.q: You should ______ a deep breath and count to ten.
questions.ex: should是情态动词，后面接动词原形。

questions.q: If you want to go to the park, you can go ______ bus.
questions.ex: by + 交通工具表示出行方式。

questions.q: Where is the post office? It's ______ the hospital.
questions.ex: next to 表示在...旁边，是常见的方位表达。

questions.q: The Robin Hood story tells us we should ______.
questions.ex: 罗宾汉的故事寓意是帮助他人。

questions.q: What is your father's job? He is a ______.
questions.ex: 由job引导的问题应回答职业名称。

questions.q: What ______ you going to do this weekend?
questions.ex: 主语是you，be动词用are。

questions.q: He likes ______ stories and singing.
questions.ex: like doing sth. 表示长期稳定的爱好。

questions.q: Your dog is ill. You are very ______.
questions.ex: 宠物生病了通常会感到难过。

o: Wait V for the V green light.
I want V to go V to the cinema.
First, V go to the bookstore.
Turn V left V at the V light.
questions.q: Which sentence has a natural pause (V)?
questions.ex: 句子开头的连接词（如First）后通常有自然停顿。

questions.q: 请将下列单词连成一句话：
questions.ex: 祈使句以动词原形开头，表示在灯前等待。

questions.q: You can send a letter in the cinema.
questions.ex: 寄信要去邮局(post office)而不是电影院。

questions.q: In the story 'The Ant and the Grasshopper', the ant is very hardworking.
questions.ex: 蚂蚁和蚱蜢的故事中，蚂蚁以勤劳(hardworking)著称。

questions.q: He likes go hiking on weekends.
questions.ex: like后面接动词ing形式，应为going。

questions.q: 'I am going to visit my teacher' 描述的是将来发生的事。
questions.ex: be going to 表示计划、打算做某事。

questions.q: The moral of a story is the same as the setting.
questions.ex: moral指故事寓意，setting指背景，两者不同。

questions.q: ______ do you go to school? By bike.
questions.ex: 回答是方式，疑问词用How。

questions.q: Turn left ______ the bookstore. Then go straight.
questions.ex: 在某个具体的地点转弯用at。

questions.q: We are going to have a party ______.
questions.ex: are going to 配合将来时间，this evening符合。

questions.q: Where is the li-nk-up (连读) in 'Stand up'?
questions.ex: Stand结尾音/d/与up开头音/ʌ/连读。

questions.q: The ______ are the people or animals in a story.
questions.ex: 故事中的人物或动物被称为角色。

questions.q: A postman works in a ______.
questions.ex: 邮递员在邮局工作。

questions.q: If you are not happy, you might feel ______.
questions.ex: 不开心即难过。

questions.q: My father ______ to work by subway.
questions.ex: 主语my father是第三人称单数，动词加es。

questions.q: Someone is ill. You should say: ______.
questions.ex: 生病时的建议是看医生。

questions.q: When you write a letter to a friend, you sign your name at the ______.
questions.ex: 署名通常在信的底部。
